By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. As the ISSO, you will serve as the hands-on security practitioner responsible for day-to-day compliance execution and vulnerability management across assigned systems. • Currently possesses and is able to maintain an active U.S. Top Secret security clearance

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Experience with Splunk SIEM configuration, log analysis, and alert tuning

• Familiarity with JSIG or ICD 503 assessment processes

• Experience working in a space systems or satellite program security environment

• Exposure to GRC platforms such as eMASS or Xacta

• Prior experience supporting security control assessments or ATO packages

• CompTIA CySA+, CEH, or GIAC certifications
